_description: CCNL Turismo Federalberghi-Faita (CNEL H052) level 4, May 2026 regular run, permanent, full time: the first month of the tranche of May 2026.
_notes: Ipotesi di accordo 5 luglio 2024, art. 152 c.1 (p. 42 of the signed scan): level 4 1.695,69 from mag 2026, paga base nazionale conglobata.
The case is a hotel with more than two stars: art. 152 c.2 sets a lower table for 1-2 star hotels and small campsites (level 4 1.688,98).
